label: 水溶解度 logS

ensemble.selection_rule: Fit seven prespecified candidates on train only. Rank by validation RMSE (name tie-break). Among the top three evaluate all pairs with least-squares simplex weights clipped to [0.1,0.9]. Use the lowest-RMSE pair only if it improves best-single validation RMSE by at least 1%; otherwise retain the best single. Freeze weights; refit selected members on train+validation. Calibration/test labels never enter candidate selection or weight fitting.

missing_value_policy: Per-estimator fit-only median; all-missing fitting column retained and filled with zero.
split_method: whole Bemis-Murcko scaffolds; all acyclic compounds share one group; seed42 largest-first; frozen from V2 byte-for-byte

aggregation: Group by non-stereochemical canonical identity; median labels. For logS prefer AqSolDB if present; frozen ESOL test uses original v1 labels.
evaluation_note: Fixed internal scaffold holdout; not external validation. Empirical split-conformal intervals do not guarantee coverage under scaffold distribution shift. Metrics include all held-out rows, including OOD rows the app may withhold.
limitations: Conditions such as temperature, pH (except logD74 definition), solid form and protocols are incompletely represented.
Reference observations may disagree; local database preserves each source record.
Fingerprint similarity and descriptor bounds are heuristics, not proof of validity.
Calibration partitions and test partitions have distinct scaffolds; nominal 90% need not be achieved.
Only seven fixed candidates; no external validation or guarantee of improvement.
Member disagreement describes the fitted models; it is not calibrated uncertainty.
V2 and V3 share a previously inspected test set; comparison is descriptive and not a fresh prospective test.

v2_same_test_comparison.note: Identical V2 rows, labels, training/validation/calibration/test assignment; no test-driven retries.

v1_same_test_comparison.note: Original 224 ESOL labels; matching test identities/scaffolds excluded from every other partition.
